effect_unit_note: Eleven populations along a fragmentation gradient; publication summary reports visitation increasing from 1.5% to 74.3% with increasing floral display. Exact coefficient/SE or raw population table must be recovered before Fisher-z admission.
extraction_notes: Do not infer a correlation from endpoint range alone. Floral display is a D/resource-support predictor and visitation is I.

effect_unit_note: Eleven-population gradient; source summary reports visitation increasing from 1.3% in more isolated populations to 5.6% with increasing connectivity. Recover model coefficient/SE or raw data before standardisation.
extraction_notes: Direction is source-reported; no effect-size calculation from percentages alone.

effect_unit_note: Small populations had an impoverished pool of weakly effective pollinators and native bees were absent in small isolated remnants. Taxon/effectiveness composition is a secondary T layer; quantitative community contrast requires full table/raw data.
extraction_notes: Use as mechanism/trait layer only after extractable community/effectiveness statistics are recovered.

effect_unit_note: Pollen quantity limitation was detected across all populations. The source does not support coding this as a fragmentation effect of zero or a binary contrast; population-level experimental treatment statistics are needed.
extraction_notes: Retain quantity limitation separately from pollen-quality limitation.

effect_unit_note: Overall pollen limitation was greater in small fragments because genetic factors reduced pollen quality/compatibility. Exact population-level treatment contrast and uncertainty must be recovered before quantitative synthesis.
extraction_notes: High-value function/compatibility response; do not equate with standing neutral genetic diversity.
